title: Steven D Probable NDE 367
content: Three years before my accidental gunshot wound accident, I was being dragged to my death by a runaway horse with my foot caught in the stirrup of the saddle. All of a sudden, my recently deceased uncle (he was killed six months earlier from a one-car roll-over) appeared and stopped the horse, took my foot out of the stirrup, winked and disappeared. For three years (1957-1960) I wanted to know about angels. I asked many church leaders in the community (Tucson) about angels. My father was a religion instructor at the University of Arizona. A Catholic Priest told me to be ready to ask many questions about my own personal life with Jesus. Another pastor told me to test any and all angels by shaking their hand to see if they were a 'spirit' or 'resurrected from the presence of the Lord'. In June, 1960 my grandpa, Rust, died in Salt Lake City, Utah at the young age of fifty-seven, due to exposure from nuclear testing in Nevada. He lived in Kanab, Utah and owned a hotel and herded cattle and sheep in the mountains. The next month my father had a visitor come from Church headquarters and assigned him a very important position in the Church (political leadership). My mother was upset about the unexpected death of her father and the important political position with her husband. In October, 1960 she was praying to God asking for answers about the death of her brother (thirty-two years, single in 1957), her father (fifty-seven years, prominent) and why her husband was never home (many important political/financial affairs). On October 26th, 1960 she had a very vivid dream about one of her four boys having a head injury and being comforted that it's okay, your son has a mission for the Lord. This experience shook her up and she presumed the accident would happen to my fifteen year old brother who had just been given a motor scooter and she feared he would have an accident in an intersection. 'Hot' Rod would never wear his helmet! My brother was grounded from using his scooter. Nobody knew this was the fear, except mom and dad. The next night, October 27, 1960 she had an identical dream about the exact same things she had the night before. She was very concerned about my brother and kept him home all day long. On October 28th, 1960 she had the same dream, as the other two nights. This time, the frustrated father took all the family on a picnic to one of his mining claims in the mountains, South of Tucson, Arizona. The year before he had shot a deer from the cab of his pick-up truck. So on the way down and back to his property the four boys were in the back of the truck with their eyes on sighting a deer. My father wanted to shoot another deer. He had been frustrated for three straight days because of the fear from his wife's dreams. His 'glory' for a successful trip was to find and shoot another trophy deer. He had his World War II rifle at his side, loaded, but on double safety. While the truck was approaching, the highway there was a gas station in sight. The kids all started to ask for a 'break' and a 'drink of pop'. My father wasn't happy. My mother used her special way and he finally agreed to stop. Forgetting his loaded rifle was at his left side, he jammed the door open, thus causing the rifle to fall, and hitting the pavement and accidently discharging the bullet. The bullet missed his shoulder; hit the back of the truck, causing the bullet to split. One piece hit me in the left temple. I don't remember the rest. They tell me that an Arizona Highway Patrolman was at the scene within minutes of the accident. The patrolman realized the critical condition of the child. He radioed ahead. He then violated the Arizona Law, put the lifeless child in the back of his patrol car along with the parents (keeping the father in his custody for potential negligent homicide charges if the child died), and sped off to the closest hospital. There so happen to be a famous head surgeon visiting the St. Mary's Catholic Hospital. (My mother was very calm and knew what to do at the scene. She quickly got my father's handkerchief and put it over the wound. An angelic hand went over hers and the bleeding stopped! My father was hysterical, not knowing what to do during the whole time! At the hospital, I remember leaving my body on the operating table and going upward. I was greeted by an angel. I wisely extended my hand and asked who his name was. He complimented me and answered, 'I come from the presence of the Lord and my name is Moroni, an ancient prophet.' For three days, while my body lay on the operating table, I had a beautiful experience with an angel of the Lord. I saw many things. I was told why I was in his presence and I had a choice to go home, or come back to my body and serve on a mission for the Lord. I was told I had made a promise before I was ever born to serve the Lord, however He saw fit for me to assist Him. I was told the terrible condition of specific things, which were not approved by the Lord. I was promised that my deceased uncle would be my guardian angel and protect me. I was also told I had my free agency and could go immediately home. I was shown a certain mountain and told this is the Lord's Mountain of Gold. I was called to protect it and I would know what to do with it in the future. Many things I experienced. I remembered it all at the time I awoke. I had been given permission to write a message from the Lord and to use it and live by it while I grew up. I was cautioned and warned to keep my mission between the Lord and me. The Lord called me to serve. The Lord would assist me in completing my mission, if I obeyed Him. I promised to keep quiet, but to document everything for thirty-five years. I was told to work hard for five more years, and then I would have my family together, forever. All these things have come true.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: He said: 'I come from the presence of the Lord and my name is Moroni, an ancient prophet.'

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: He was told he could 'come back to my body and serve on a mission for the Lord' and was 'called to protect' 'the Lord's Mountain of Gold.' He was cautioned to keep the mission 'between the Lord and me' and to document everything for thirty-five years.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Accidental discharge of a loaded rifle; bullet fragment hit his left temple.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Latter-day Saint/Mormon context implied (angel identified as Moroni; church headquarters; mission language).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Shown 'the Lord's Mountain of Gold' and commissioned to protect it; given permission to write a message; told to keep mission private and document for 35 years.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE from operating table, greeted by an angel, received teachings/commission and choice to return; no tunnel or life review described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Mother reported an 'angelic hand' over hers stopping bleeding at the scene; angel identified himself by name after a handshake test; 'Lord's Mountain of Gold' commission; instruction to document for thirty-five years; earlier (1957) crisis where deceased uncle appeared and stopped a runaway horse.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I come from the presence of the Lord and my name is Moroni, an ancient prophet.”
